name: sellwinners
description: E-commerce and advertising research from your SellWinners account: find winning products and Shopify stores, search Meta, Google and TikTok ads, brief competitors, read their email strategy, track brands and save findings to boards.

interface.longDescription:
SellWinners brings e-commerce and advertising research into ChatGPT. Ask in plain language and it searches the SellWinners index of Shopify stores, products, ads and brand emails for you.

What you can do:
- Find winning products: the best sellers of the fastest-growing stores in a niche.
- Research ads: search Meta (Facebook and Instagram), Google and TikTok ads by keyword, brand, country, format and reach, with their copy, hooks and creatives.
- Brief a competitor: a store's products, ads, emails and similar stores in one answer.
- Read an email strategy: how often a brand sends, on which days, which campaigns, and its latest subjects.
- Track brands: follow competitors and see who launched or scaled ads in the last day or week.
- Organise your research: save ads, shops and emails to your SellWinners boards and favorites.

Connecting asks you to sign in to your SellWinners account and allow access; you can disconnect at any time from your SellWinners dashboard. What the tools can do depends on your SellWinners account, and tool calls count toward its usage. Tools that delete something or create a public share link need your explicit confirmation.
capabilities: Find winning products and fast-growing Shopify stores in a niche
Search Meta, Google and TikTok ads by keyword, brand, country, format and reach
Brief a competitor: products, ads, emails and similar stores
Analyse a brand's marketing emails and sending calendar
Track brands and get a daily digest of their new and scaling ads
Save ads, shops and emails to boards and favorites
defaultPrompt: Find winning products in the home fitness niche that are selling right now
Show the top-performing TikTok ads for skincare this month
Give me a competitor brief on allbirds.com

positive.prompt: Use SellWinners to find winning products in the pet supplies niche for the keywords dog harness and dog bed.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_winning_products with the niche and keywords, then lists best-selling products with their title, price, the store that sells them and a link.

positive.prompt: Find the highest-reach video ads for protein powder running in the United Kingdom.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_ads with the words protein powder, video media, country GB and a reach ranking, then lists ads with the brand, ad copy, reach, how long each has run and a link to the creative.

positive.prompt: Give me a competitor brief on allbirds.com: its best products, its ads and its emails.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls brief_competitor for allbirds.com and summarises the store's profile, best-selling products, recent ads and recent marketing emails.

positive.prompt: How often does gymshark.com send marketing emails, on which days, and what were its latest subject lines?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls analyze_shop_emails for gymshark.com and reports the sending frequency, the busiest days, the dominant campaign types and the latest subject lines.

positive.description: Save research to a board (writes to the account)
positive.prompt: Find TikTok ads for LED face masks and save the one with the most likes to a new SellWinners board called Skincare ideas.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_tiktok_library, creates a collection board named Skincare ideas with create_board, saves the chosen ad with add_board_item, and confirms the board name and the saved ad.

negative.prompt: What will the weather be in Paris tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: SellWinners is not used: it has no weather data. ChatGPT answers on its own or says it can't.

negative.description: Purchase request the plugin cannot do
negative.prompt: Use SellWinners to order 500 units of the best-selling dog harness for me.
negative.expected_behavior: No order is placed and no tool that changes anything is called. ChatGPT explains that SellWinners provides product and ad research only, and can offer to find the best-selling dog harnesses instead.

negative.prompt: Use SellWinners to get the home address and personal phone number of the founder of allbirds.com.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool is called for this. ChatGPT declines: SellWinners has no personal contact details of individuals, only data about stores, products, ads and marketing emails.

publication.release_notes: First release: product, store, ad, email and brand research from SellWinners in ChatGPT, with boards, favorites and brand tracking, through a sign-in to your SellWinners account. Four skills guide ChatGPT through product research, ad creative research, competitor briefs and brand tracking.
